| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| τὸν δὲ χολωσάμενος προσεφώνεεν Ἶρος ἀλήτης (whole-line speech introduction, 18.25; the reply-formula built on a participle and a name + epithet) | "And him, enraged, addressed Irus the vagrant:" | "Then Irus the vagrant, enraged, spoke to him:" | "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο); "angrily replied" |
| τοῖς δὲ δολοφρονέων μετέφη πολύμητις Ὀδυσσεύς (whole-line speech introduction, 18.51) | "And among them, with guile in his mind, spoke many-wiled Odysseus:" | "Among them Odysseus of many wiles, with guile in his mind, spoke:" | "plotting", "scheming" (each drops φρήν "mind"), "addressed" (reserved for προσέφη); builds on the table's μετέφη "spoke among" and πολύμητις "many-wiled" |
| Ἶρος Ἄϊρος (18.73, pun on the nickname) | "Irus, Un-Irus" | "Irus, who will be Irus no more" | "Irus the Irusless", "Non-Irus" (hyphen kept to show the negative prefix) |
| ἐπίσπαστον κακόν (18.73) | "an evil drawn on himself" | "an evil he has drawn down on himself" | "a self-inflicted harm" (loses ἐπισπάω "draw on"), "a trouble of his own making" |
| γρηῒ καμινοῖ ἶσος (18.27; καμινώ, a rare noun, "woman who tends the furnace") | "like an old furnace-woman" | "just like an old furnace-woman" | "oven-hag", "kiln-woman", "an old crone at the oven" (each adds a tone the Greek does not show) |
| ἐπιτροχάδην (18.26) | "glibly" | "glibly" | "at a run", "fluently", "volubly" |
| γαστὴρ μάργη (18.2, μάργῃ; adjective of the belly) | "a frenzied belly" | "a ravenous belly" | "mad belly", "greedy belly" in `l`; the table's μάργος "Madman" (16.421) keeps the first sense in `l`, and `i` takes the sense the context needs (+ note: the dictionaries give both) |
| κνίσης ἐμπλήσαντες (18.45, of paunches stuffed with κνίση and blood) | "having filled them with fat" | "after stuffing them with fat" | "the smell of fat" (the table's κνίση 17.270 is the smell of cooking fat, which cannot fill a paunch), "savour" (+ note says why κνίση here is the fat itself) |
| βουγάϊε (voc., 18.79; meaning not known) | "braggart" | "braggart" (+ note: meaning not known; 'braggart' is the usual guess) | "bully", "big-mouth", "ox-glorier" (each picks one guess or builds on βοῦς "ox") |
| κοίρανος (18.106, ξείνων καὶ πτωχῶν κοίρανος εἶναι) | "ruler" | "ruler" | "lord" (reserved for ἄναξ), "master", "king" (reserved for βασιλεύς) |
| δρηστῆρες (18.76) | "serving-men" | "serving-men" | "servants" (reserved for δμῶες), "attendants" (reserved for θεράπων / ἀμφίπολοι); joins the table's ὑποδρηστήρ "serving-men" |
| ἀπώμνυον (18.58; ἀπόμνυμι "swear not to") | "swore" | "swore" (+ note: ἀπο- makes it an oath of refusal) | "swore off", "forswore" (suggests breaking an oath) |
